testing_mode: RED

Add function test_built_agents_contain_severity_calibration_rubric_heading to tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh. The function reads real agent files from plugins/dso/agents/ and asserts each code-reviewer-*.md contains '^## Severity Calibration Rubric'. This test must FAIL before Task 4 (agents don't yet contain the rubric heading).

Gate 2 note: codebase is green after this task alone — the new test is intentionally RED and tolerated via RED marker in .test-index. The pre-commit test gate respects RED markers and will not block commit.

Also update .test-index to add a RED marker: plugins/dso/scripts/build-review-agents.sh entry must include tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh [test_built_agents_contain_severity_calibration_rubric_heading].

## Files to Modify
- tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh (MODIFY)
- .test-index (MODIFY — append RED marker to build-review-agents.sh source entry)

## Acceptance Criteria
- REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
- grep -q 'test_built_agents_contain_severity_calibration_rubric_heading' "$REPO_ROOT/tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh"
- grep -q 'test-build-review-agents.sh \[test_built_agents_contain_severity_calibration_rubric_heading\]' "$REPO_ROOT/.test-index" (RED marker present with bracket format)
- Direct run shows FAIL (RED): bash "$REPO_ROOT/tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh" 2>&1 | grep 'test_built_agents_contain_severity_calibration_rubric_heading' | grep -q 'FAIL'
